concept.title: Advice, advocacy and practical support
concept.shortdesc: Individual help, advice and support including advocacy, benefits and debt advice, signposting, helplines, domestic abuse support and help with appointments.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Receiving or providing advocacy, where someone speaks up for a person or helps them have their voice heard in health, social care and other decisions.
: Receiving emotional, psychological or practical support, including combined emotional and practical help.
: Receiving individual support from a worker or volunteer on a one-to-one basis, often with information, advice or skills help.
: Support, advice, information and safe accommodation for people affected by domestic abuse, sexual violence or other forms of abuse and violence.
: Being pointed or referred on to other organisations, services or professionals that can provide the right help.
: Getting information, checks and help to understand, claim and apply for benefits, grants and other financial support.
: Practical help to book, prepare for, get to or be accompanied at appointments, meetings and hearings.
: Advice and practical support with managing money, budgeting, debt, bills and financial worries.
: Getting information, advice, emotional support or counselling by speaking to someone on a telephone helpline or phone call.
